name: Misa
message: 「Ugh, come on! Answer it already! It's distracting!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Helena gave you one the other day, remember?」
She said she'd let me know first thing once Azel was found!
As I hurriedly pulled the phone from my pocket
Azel was just about to run out of the church plaza.
Seeing Azel again felt like it had been forever, and
Azel stepped back toward the plaza.

name: Synn
message: 「Ever since you disappeared, you're all I've been thinking about.」
With every step I take forward, Azel steps back.

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'm sure that for a long time now, all I've been thinking about is you, Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「You know, Nanaka confessed to me... but I turned her down.」
Azel is telling me to stop.

name: Synn
message: 「I like Nanaka, she's important to me, and I knew she was serious, too, but still... I couldn't accept her feelings.」

name: Synn
message: 「Because there was already a girl I liked. That's why.」
Yet I can't stop. There's no stopping it now.

name: Synn
message: 「I don't know how you feel about me, Azel, but I love you.」
With a strange expression that looked like she was both crying and smiling, Azel--
